notes: Two A3 nodes, 16 logical NPUs each. TP32/DP8 is a historical candidate, not a validated or frozen release recipe.
Replace every __FILL_*__ placeholder in a private local copy. Paths must be the actual absolute paths inside both containers.
Keep the filled configuration and runtime evidence on the test machines; they contain local paths, network addresses and model details.
context_length does not allocate KV capacity. Client preflight must check the running service before any 128k request.
max_running_requests=8 is divided by attention DP8, requesting one running request per DP worker; read effective_max_running_requests_per_dp after startup.
